_comment: Perk adapter: Path of Sorcery 3.2. Its own keywords, defined in PathOfSorcery.esp, which puts
them on the vanilla effects vanilla gave no keyword: the Dragonborn poison rune (poison),
Dawnguard sun fire and Stendarr's aura (holy), Dremora Lord, Seeker and Ash Guardian (daedra).
perkMod: Path of Sorcery - Magic Perk Overhaul 3.2

adapters.why: by race: the summoned actor's race is daedra, and no fire, frost or storm summon keyword

summoned daedra not already marked as a fire, frost or storm summon - Path of Sorcery itself puts it on Dremora Lord, Seeker and Ash Guardian; fire, frost and storm atronachs pass its perks through MagicSummonFire/Frost/Shock instead. Atronachs of other elements (necrotic, shadow) do get it
